PART_B.NOTE_STRUCT_COMBOS: STRUCT+NERX / STRUCT+KNN / STRUCT+NERX+KNN are structurally GUARANTEED to be 0 for every corpus, not an empirical finding: NERX=NER\STRUCT and KNN=A\STRUCT are defined as set-differences against STRUCT everywhere in this codebase, so any pair with a STRUCT edge is by construction excluded from the NERX/KNN key arrays. The only meaningful buckets are STRUCT, NERX, KNN, NERX+KNN, and NONE.
